title: fix(plugin-security): canReadObject, getReadFilter and security/explain answer the delegated business-unit read as the read door does
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi9Hju7DThD7eoLKoJU9hnHj)_

Fixes #30758

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：委托管理员（只持有某个业务单元子树的 adminScope）能读到的业务单元，现在 `canReadObject`、`getReadFilter` 和 `security/explain` 都如实回答“能读，且只能读这几个”，与读门（find/findOne/count/aggregate）一致。
- 为什么改：读门早已按裁决放行这类读取，但三处“回答”仍说不能读，单元选择器和 explain 会拒绝委托管理员实际能读的单元（多拒，不多放）。
- 风险与回滚：三处都复用读门同一个判断函数，`canReadObject` 变 true 时 `getReadFilter` 同步收窄到所覆盖单元，绕过中间件的门不会读到范围外单元；回滚即还原本 PR 一个提交。
- 先看：`security-plugin-read-filter.ts`（收窄，最关键）、`explain-engine.ts`（object_crud 与记录级判定）、`security-plugin-object-admission.ts`（第 5 臂的补充）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run src/delegated-admin-own-name-set.posture.test.ts`，预期 57/57 通过，其中 #30758 新增的 24 个用例覆盖三种租户姿态。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

A delegated administrator reads the business units its admin scopes cover (ADR-0090 D12, ruling of record 6663849489). The read door admits that read beside the CRUD grant (`delegatedUnitReadScope`, which reached `main` in eb96480dd60c, the squash of #31031; #30747 itself closed unmerged). The answers outside the door did not reflect it. This PR makes them ask the door's own judgment; it does not change what the door admits.

- `delegated-admin-gate.ts`: the judgment is split out as `delegatedUnitReadAdmission(gate, object, operation, context, sets, delegatorSets)`. `delegatedUnitReadScope` (the door's call) now checks only that the read carries a query and hands the rest to it, so there is one judgment and no second copy. Conditions are unchanged: a read (`find`, `findOne`, `count`, `aggregate`) of `sys_business_unit`, own behalf, gate composed, at least one covered unit, fail closed.
- `canReadObject`: arm 5 (the `find` grant) accepts, where no set grants, the same admission the middleware makes at step 2. Arms 3, 4 and 6 are unchanged and still run. Object-level "some rows" follows the plugin's existing precedent for every row-restricted read: `canReadObject` answers `true` and `getReadFilter` carries the rows (its docblock: "`true` never means unrestricted — the row scope is still getReadFilter's").
- `getReadFilter`: where no set grants `find`, the same admission's confinement (an `id` `$in` filter over the covered units) is ANDed in beside RLS and controlled-by-parent, as step 3 ANDs it. Without this half, flipping `canReadObject` alone would have let a bypassing door read every unit of the organization (measured below).
- `security/explain`: a new optional dep `delegatedUnitReadScope` (wired to the same judgment). `object_crud` grants through it only where the principal's sets do not; the `rls` layer's `readFilter` carries the confinement; the record pass reports a unit outside the scope as not visible (`decidedBy: object_crud`), which matters when an organization administrator explains the delegate. `export`, writes and on-behalf-of principals are not admitted, as at their doors.

Before, measured on this branch's base 5f0037449 with the new posture tests, identical in all three postures (`single`, `group`, `isolated`), delegate scope over `bu_east` + subtree, `bu_hq` outside:

| question | read door | before | after |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `find` / `findOne` / `count` / `aggregate` | `bu_east`, `bu_east_field` | same | same |
| `canReadObject('sys_business_unit')` | | `false` | `true` |
| units under `getReadFilter` | | all three, `bu_hq` included | `bu_east`, `bu_east_field` |
| `explain` read: `allowed` / `object_crud` | | `false` / `denies` | `true` / `grants` |
| units under `explain`'s `readFilter` | | all three | `bu_east`, `bu_east_field` |
| `explain` record `bu_east` / `bu_hq` | | not visible / not visible | visible / not visible |

## Tests

One new top-level `describe` in the existing shared harness `delegated-admin-own-name-set.posture.test.ts` (real `ObjectQL` over SQLite with the real `SecurityPlugin`), eight cases per posture:

- `canReadObject` admits the delegate, and `getReadFilter` returns exactly the read door's units.
- `security/explain` read: allowed, `object_crud` grants, `readFilter` returns exactly the door's units.
- `security/explain` of one unit, asked by the delegate and by its organization administrator: covered units visible, `bu_hq` not.
- `aggregate`: inside the scope counts the covered units, a `where` on `bu_hq` counts none, and a `groupBy` on an FLS-unreadable field is refused by step 2.5b (`forbiddenFields: ['external_ref']`).
- CONTROLs: a caller with no scope is refused by door, `canReadObject` and explain alike; an organization administrator's answers are unchanged; acting on behalf of another user (even one who reads every unit) admits nothing anywhere; explain still denies `create` and `export`, and `canExport` stays `false`.

The `east_admin` fixture set gains one field rule (`sys_business_unit.external_ref` unreadable) so 2.5b has a field to refuse.

<details><summary>Ablations: every negative pin turned red, then restored by hash</summary>

Each leg ran through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit x1 → x0, replacement x0 → x1), restored with `git checkout HEAD -- PATH`, then checked by `git hash-object` against the HEAD blob and an empty `git diff HEAD`. The test imports the plugin from `src`, so no build sits between the mutation and the run.

| leg | mutation | red |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A1 | `getReadFilter` drops the unit scope | 3/57: units read `bu_east, bu_east_field, bu_hq` |
| A2 | explain `filterParts` drops the unit scope | 3/57: explain read `readFilter` |
| A3 | explain record pass drops the unit-scope check | 3/57: `organization administrator · bu_hq: expected true to be false` |
| A4 | middleware step 3 drops `extra.push(delegatedUnitScope)` | 15/57, including the aggregate pin: `['east:1','east_field:1','hq:1']` |
| A5 | step 2.5b condition `aggregate` renamed away | 3/57: `forbiddenFields` `undefined` (step 2.9 still refuses, without naming the field) |
| A6 | `canReadObject` passes `null` for the delegator sets | 3/57: on-behalf-of control, `expected true to be false` |
| A6b | explain wiring passes `null` for the delegator sets | 3/57: on-behalf-of control |
| A7 | explain wiring asks `find` instead of the explained operation | 3/57: `create: expected true to be false` |
| A8 | `canReadObject` treats a null admission as admitted | 6/57: no-scope control and on-behalf-of control |

A first A6 run against a delegator holding no read of `sys_business_unit` stayed green: arm 6 (the delegator's own grant) already refuses it. The control now names a delegator who reads every unit, which is the case only the judgment's own on-behalf-of condition refuses; A6 and A6b are red against that version (commit 7792e807).
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `canReadObject` is also asked by the engine's `ReadableIds` composition over a master (ADR-0139). An app object that is `controlled_by_parent` with `sys_business_unit` as its master would now let a delegate read that object's rows under the covered units, where it read none before. No platform object is such a detail (searched `packages/platform-objects/src`), and ADR-0055 makes reading a detail follow reading its master, so this follows the ruled read rather than widening past it. The seat should confirm this reading.
- `objectReadAdmission`'s other asker is unchanged: it hands no fallback, so only `canReadObject` gains the delegated read.
- Out of scope per the order and untouched: the ADR-0090 D12 note and the `reference_not_found` comment in `packages/spec/src/api/errors.zod.ts`.
